name: Superpowers Pack
description: The complete pinned obra/superpowers engineering workflow: discovery, planning, test-first implementation, systematic debugging, parallel collaboration, review, verification, branch completion, skill authoring, and agent distribution descriptors.

codex.notes: Pinned skills validate and install through the Codex target.

claude-code.notes: Pinned skills validate and install through the Claude Code target.

cursor.notes: Portable Agent Skills are compatible; native distribution remains agent-managed.

gemini.notes: Portable Agent Skills are compatible; native extension behavior remains agent-managed.

opencode.notes: Portable Agent Skills are compatible; native plugin behavior remains agent-managed.

copilot.notes: Portable Agent Skills can be installed for the Copilot target.

recommendation.reason: Flagship end-to-end engineering workflow from discovery through verified, reviewed completion.

useCases: Install the complete obra/superpowers skill library — workflow, debugging, collaboration, and authoring — in one pack.
Give a coding agent the full Superpowers methodology from idea refinement through verified, reviewed completion.
Use one portable workflow suite across Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, and Copilot targets while retaining upstream provenance.
examplePrompts: Use the Superpowers workflow to take this feature from brainstorm to a finished, verified branch.
Apply systematic-debugging from this pack to find the root cause of this failing test.
Break this approved plan into independent tasks, dispatch parallel agents safely, request code review, and verify the branch before completion.
